run_spot_viewer: run the spot viewer GUI application with a specified scene file and physics enabled
create_spot_agent: create a SpotAgent instance to load and control a Spot robot in the Habitat simulator
move_spot_robot: move the Spot robot forward, backward, laterally, or rotate it using WASD and QE keys
toggle_spot_navmesh: toggle the Spot robot navmesh clipping constraint to enable or disable no-clip mode
edit_scene_objects: edit scene objects by selecting, moving, rotating, duplicating, or removing them with keyboard controls
